what_happens: A heavily motion-blurred person crosses from the stairs on the left toward the centre in about 1.6 s, covering much more ground than nearby walkers.
A motion-blurred person comes down from the stairs and moves quickly past the walkers around them, covering about a third of the frame in under a second.
A child in red stands close to the camera beside the pink bag, looks at something in their hands and finally bends or crouches down at the bag; no throwing or running is visible.
A person with a backpack walks toward the camera, passes very close to it and then walks away at a normal pace.
A person in blue trousers runs with long strides from right to left across the whole frame in under 2 s.
A person in blue trousers runs/leaps with long strides from left to right across the frame in about 1.5 s.
A man in grey with blue trousers swings his black bag around, with the bag flung out away from his body at 28.2 s and moving in the air at the frame edge at 31.4 s.
A person in a light jacket only partly visible at the right edge of the frame stands or steps in place for about a quarter second, with no clear action.
A small person in a light blue jacket crosses the plaza from right to left with a blurred, wide-stride running posture, covering much more ground per frame than the walkers nearby.
A person in a light blue jacket moves quickly from left to right across the plaza with long, blurred strides, faster than the people walking in the background.
A man with a backpack walks slowly away from the camera close to the left edge of the frame.
A person in a light blue jacket runs across the plaza from right to left, appearing motion-blurred with long strides.
A man with a backpack walks normally into view at the right edge, close to the camera.
A man throws a black bag high into the air; it lands on the ground, he bends to pick it up, and he throws it into the air again before it lands once more.
A man bends over a bag lying on the ground, grabs it, and swings it upward as if to throw it.
A man throws a black bag up into the air; it falls to the ground and he bends down to pick it up.

A man in blue trousers picks his bag up off the ground and throws it high into the air (the bag is airborne at 4.7s), then bends to pick it up again; the box also briefly follows a woman in a pink coat walking past quickly.
A woman holding a coat and a shopping bag walks toward the camera at a normal pace and leaves the frame at the right.
A person comes in from the left edge pulling or pushing a red wheeled bag or trolley near the stairs. Nothing is visibly dropped or left behind.
A man in blue trousers throws a bundle of papers high into the air, and they scatter and land on the pavement, where they are left.
A man in a denim jacket with a backpack walks toward the camera at a normal pace and passes close to it.
A man in a white hoodie stands in one spot, raises an arm as if waving or gesturing, then stands with his hands behind his back.
The same man in the white hoodie stays in one spot for about 13 s, moving his arms and swinging or kicking his legs in a dance-like or stretching way.
A man in a navy and white jacket walks toward the camera at a normal pace until he fills the right side of the frame.
A child in a light-blue jacket runs from right to left across the plaza, with long strides and motion blur in every frame.
